# OD Next Marketing Task Profile（fixture 摘录）

（原文 L36-40：默认交付 = 单文件 HTML 源码）

For editable marketing layout work, the default deliverable is the source
for the chosen visual system: a single-file HTML source artifact with the
canvas sized to the channel spec, one canvas per size. Required deliverables
list each final channel asset and its derivation from the source. Multi-size
work uses composed variants, not an undifferentiated scale.
